title: Pixel Dungeon VR
description:
Pixel Dungeon is a fast-paced, multiplayer social VR adventure where dungeon-crawling action, physics-based combat, and chaos with friends collide.🏆A Meta Quest EssentialRecognized in Meta’s Best of 2025, Pixel Dungeon stands as a premier title in the Action and Adventure categories with 4.8-star rating. Join a legendary community and see why it’s a Meta Quest must-play.

 
 Search "Pixel Dungeon: Prologue" on Steam,  try out co-op gameplay and limited map content!

⚔️Squads Up & Dungeon Chaos• Team up in 4-player squads or hang out in 10-player lobbies！

• No Limits: Full game owners can host their friends—even those who haven't purchased yet—to explore the entire dungeon together!

 

 💥Epic Boss Battles, 2nd Stage Power-Up• 4 Bosses to Conquer: Skull King slashes his axe. Ghost Lord shoots bullets that chase you. Fight them!

• Second Stage: Angel becomes a giant eye monster, firing deadly lasers that burn the ground beneath you. God of Time shatters the ground, forcing everyone into a new arena —battles upgrade are so exciting!

⚔️Rich Weapons & Heroes• Hack-n-slash with Katana, claws and bows that feel real. Every hit, block, and strike is based on physics!

• BOSS Weapons: Crush your bosses with legendary gear and feel the power!

• Unique Heroes: The Witcher, Black Knight, Bird Man...choose your heroes!
